overview: Built two connected n8n workflows for a healthcare business to automate invoice and therapy confirmation document generation.

The system pulls relevant deals from HubSpot, collects patient and doctor information, generates the required documents, stores them in Google Drive, and keeps all records synchronized with Google Sheets.
Automated HubSpot to SwissQR Invoices Workflow 📄.mp4

blocks.p: The invoice workflow runs automatically each morning and processes eligible HubSpot deals based on their stage, doctor, and appointment type.

list: Generates a Swiss QR payment code
Creates the invoice PDF through PDFMonkey
Uploads the invoice and QR code to Google Drive
Records invoice details in Google Sheets

blocks.p: A separate workflow generates therapy confirmation documents for qualifying treatment sessions.

list: Matches doctor details through Google Sheets
Formats and validates the required information
Uploads the document to Google Drive
Records the document details in Google Sheets

blocks.p: The invoice workflow connects with a custom Google Cloud Run API using a .NET Swiss QR library to generate payment QR codes containing the required billing information.

result: A reliable document automation system that replaced manual invoice and therapy confirmation work with an automated process from HubSpot data to completed PDFs, Swiss QR billing, cloud storage, and record tracking.
The system also provides a structured foundation that can be extended to additional document and administrative workflows.
